changeSet.author: muw-ophthalmology

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM imaging_modality WHERE code IN ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'OCTA_PLEXELITE') AND COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '') NOT LIKE '%dicom%' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

changeSet.comment: Clarus and PlexElite accept DICOM exports as well as image files.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality SET kinds_accepted = CASE WHEN COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '') = '' THEN 'dicom' ELSE 'dicom,' || kinds_accepted END WHERE code IN ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'OCTA_PLEXELITE') AND COALESCE(kinds_accepted, '') NOT LIKE '%dicom%';

rollback.sql: UPDATE imaging_modality SET kinds_accepted = CASE WHEN kinds_accepted = 'dicom' THEN '' ELSE REPLACE(kinds_accepted, 'dicom,', '') END WHERE code IN ('FUNDUS_CLARUS', 'OCTA_PLEXELITE') AND kinds_accepted LIKE 'dicom%';
